exposure: Participation in the Istanbul Birth Academy's Childbirth Educator and Doula Training (CEDT) program
outcome: Support for upright positions during birth
cohort: The study participants were 112 obstetricians (mean age 44.1 years, 57% female), some of whom had completed a Childbirth Educator and Doula Training program.
finding: Multidisciplinary childbirth educator-doula training for obstetricians is associated with fewer routine intrapartum interventions and lower primary cesarean rates among nulliparous patients.
mod_finding: CEDT-trained clinicians reported lower primary cesarean rates in nulliparas and more often supported instinctive pushing and upright positions during birth.
